calendar_days.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE calendar_days (day TEXT PRIMARY KEY, month_key TEXT NOT NULL, day_index INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE)

stores.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE stores (store_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL)

categories.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE categories (category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category_name TEXT NOT NULL)

products.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(category_id), product_name TEXT NOT NULL, list_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(list_price_cents>=0), reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reorder_level>=0), active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)))
products.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  category_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  list_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(list_price_cents>=0),
  reorder_level INT NOT NULL CHECK(reorder_level>=0),
  active INT NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(category_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

customers.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_name TEXT NOT NULL, signup_date TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT)

promotions.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE promotions (promotion_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, promotion_name TEXT NOT NULL, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL)

traffic_sources.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE traffic_sources (source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_name TEXT NOT NULL)

marketing_campaigns.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE marketing_campaigns (campaign_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES traffic_sources(source_id), month_key TEXT NOT NULL, spend_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(spend_cents>=0), UNIQUE(source_id,month_key))
marketing_campaigns.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE marketing_campaigns (
  campaign_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  month_key CHAR(7) NOT NULL,
  spend_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(spend_cents>=0),
  UNIQUE(source_id,month_key),
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES traffic_sources(source_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

customer_sessions.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE customer_sessions (session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id), source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES traffic_sources(source_id), session_date TEXT NOT NULL)
customer_sessions.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE customer_sessions (
  session_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  source_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  session_date DATE NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES traffic_sources(source_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

orders.description: 销售订单（线上线下统一）

columns.name: channel
columns.description: store 线下 / online 线上

columns.name: status
columns.description: 业务状态（见表约束及口径）

orders.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store_id INTEGER REFERENCES stores(store_id), customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(customer_id), session_id INTEGER REFERENCES customer_sessions(session_id), order_date TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN ('store','online')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','pending')), CHECK((channel='online' AND store_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL) OR (channel='store' AND store_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NULL)))
orders.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  store_id BIGINT,
  customer_id BIGINT,
  session_id BIGINT,
  order_date DATE NOT NULL,
  channel VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN ('store','online')),
  status VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','pending')),
  CHECK((channel='online' AND store_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL) OR (channel='store' AND store_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NULL)),
  FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES stores(store_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES customer_sessions(session_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

order_items.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE order_items (order_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id), promotion_id INTEGER REFERENCES promotions(promotion_id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0), discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(discount_cents>=0), unit_cost_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0), CHECK(discount_cents<=quantity*unit_price_cents))
order_items.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_item_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  promotion_id BIGINT,
  quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),
  unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price_cents>=0),
  discount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(discount_cents>=0),
  unit_cost_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_cost_cents>=0),
  CHECK(discount_cents<=quantity*unit_price_cents),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES promotions(promotion_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

returns.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE returns (return_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES order_items(order_item_id), return_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), refund_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(refund_cents>=0))
returns.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE returns (
  return_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  return_date DATE NOT NULL,
  quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),
  refund_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(refund_cents>=0),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id) REFERENCES order_items(order_item_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

payments.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id), payment_date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>=0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('settled','failed')))
payments.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE payments (
  payment_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  payment_date DATE NOT NULL,
  amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>=0),
  status VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('settled','failed')),

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

raw_order_import.description: 原始导入脏数据隔离区
raw_order_import.sqliteDDL: CREATE TABLE raw_order_import (raw_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_ref TEXT, raw_date TEXT, raw_customer TEXT, raw_amount TEXT)
raw_order_import.mysqlDDL:
CREATE TABLE raw_order_import (
  raw_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_ref VARCHAR(160),
  raw_date VARCHAR(160),
  raw_customer VARCHAR(160),
  raw_amount VARCHAR(160)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

views.v_sales_lines: CREATE VIEW v_sales_lines AS SELECT i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.store_id,o.customer_id,o.session_id,o.channel,o.order_date,i.product_id,i.promotion_id,i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0) AS net_qty,i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS net_cents,(i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0))*i.unit_cost_cents AS cost_cents,i.discount_cents,COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS refund_cents FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(quantity) qty,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM returns WHERE return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id WHERE o.status='completed'
views.v_order_net: CREATE VIEW v_order_net AS SELECT order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents FROM v_sales_lines GROUP BY order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date
